paper_title: The Grenoble Axion Haloscope platform (GrAHal): development plan and first results
notes: GrAHal pathfinding run sets g_agamma <= 2.2e-13 GeV^-1 (22x KSVZ) at 6.375 GHz (m_a = 26.37 ueV) with 95% CL, assuming axions constitute all local DM. Limit is over a narrow tuning range; single representative point extracted from text. Local DM density value not explicitly stated numerically. | Vision: The GrAHal first-result exclusion appears as a narrow vertical magenta band near m_a ~ 2.6e-5 eV (~6.375 GHz, consistent with FIG 3/4). The plot is a summary axion-photon landscape; GrAHal's own limit is a single narrow mass region rather than a continuous boundary, so only a few representative points along the GrAHal feature are given. Other curves (ADMX, RBF, HAYSTAC, CAPP, ORGAN, CAST) are external limits. Extraction confidence is limited because the GrAHal contribution is a thin vertical line whose precise extent is hard to read. | Calibration: Benchmark KSVZ consistent (ratio=0.96) | No calibration needed
